items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 48:1
items.html: The more a thing’s form is close and equal to its fellow’s, the nearer to it it is discerned to be. (Part 1, Chapter 1, Inner Light, Item 3)
